active.summary: Refunds can double-apply when the provider retries a webhook
active.description: Provider redelivers refund webhooks on timeout. We apply the refund per delivery, so a slow response can refund twice. Needs an idempotency key on the refund path.

active.summary: Retry storm against the payments provider under partial outage
active.description: Fixed-interval retries synchronise across pods and hammer the provider. Add jittered exponential backoff with a cap. PR #418 open.

active.summary: Checkout latency p99 regressed after the address-validation rollout
active.description: p99 up ~180ms since the address-validation service went live. Suspect a synchronous call in the hot path.

watched.summary: Move the payments client onto the shared transport layer
watched.description: Depends on the retry policy landing in net/transport first (PROJ-244).
